sentence: This project studies how families build imagination and creative confidence through hands-on learning in science and technology.
This project studies how aerosols in air help bacteria that resist antibiotics to spread and adapt.
This project plans how to protect patient data in virtual reality healthcare training from future quantum computers.
This project measures uranium, thorium and protactinium in Arctic Ocean sediment cores to learn how deep ocean currents moved them.
This project gives researchers access to commercial cloud resources through one service and helps them manage their accounts.
This project studies how sunlight changes oil compounds and how long it takes.
This project studies how well clustering, the task of grouping similar objects, can be efficiently approximated.
This project uses ultrasound to make light deep inside the body for precise gene editing in live mice.
This project builds tools in the Rust programming language that control how information flows through software to keep it secure.
This project designs AI decision aids that get people to engage and think carefully about the AI's advice.
This project builds materials from nanoscale DNA building blocks that can change shape and pass along signals.
This project studies how nano-sized particles called precipitates change how shape memory alloys recover their shape.
This project studies how green algae remember heat stress across generations and whether epigenetic regulation explains it.
This project builds a Capture-the-Flag platform with challenges that teach software and systems security.
This project studies moduli spaces, which are shapes defined by polynomial equations, and how they connect to machine learning.
This project builds tools that help scientists train AI science models on hardware with massive parallelism.
